title: After the Navy: Bunk Johnson concert, port job and joining Celestin
summary: Back from the Navy he plays the St. Charles Hotel with Bunk Johnson and George Lewis, works at the port, loses his mother and brother, is laid off in 1950, then joins Celestin's band replacing Louis Barbarin.

story.theme_name: Making a living: hard times, day jobs and scarce work
story.community_name: The Depression years and the WPA band
